description: MainActivity.java defines an Android activity that manages a user interface with a log display and a fragment showing active notifications. It handles menu options to toggle log visibility and initializes logging components.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages notification display and logging UI, including menu handling and logging initialization.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the ActiveNotificationsFragment if no saved state exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Updates menu items based on current UI state, such as log visibility.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with wrappers and filters, and links to a LogFragment for on-screen display.
